change: One ESIMD launch commits consecutive GDN layers, reusing the retained eight-column, 256-GRF recurrence and fused history update. Verifier respects stage bounds, global input ordinals and local state offsets; no pointer tables or staging allocations.
baseline: Current retained per-layer fused GDN history/state commit, with QSA device-position batch commit already enabled. The isolated engine changes only GDN commit kernels and verifier dispatch relative to the previous validation engine.
measurement_scope: GDN commit operator stage only, 36 distinct layers. No fresh steady-state whole-model decode/prefill speedup measurement. Earlier optimization percentages must not be added or multiplied.
dispatch: ACM G10; verification capacity4/6; state size128 and convolution length4; more than one GDN layer in the verifier stage. Other calls retain the current per-layer fallback.

confirmation.method: Three fresh processes, each shape runs A/B/A/B/A in one process using the same kernel object. A submits one fused history/state kernel per layer; B submits one kernel for all36 layers. Submit thread affinity and above-normal process priority are identical. Each phase resets state, validates the complete state buffer, warms three batches of64 sequences and retains nine batches of128; one queue completion per batch. Reported medians combine all nine baseline and six candidate phase medians across processes. Conservative reduction compares the slowest candidate phase median with the fastest baseline phase median for each shape; no phases discarded.
confirmation.conditions: A770, Windows10, driver32.0.101.9034, DPC++2025.3.2, Level Zero; 36 independent layers with distinct data; state rows contain recurrence followed by three history values per channel; key heads16, value heads48, channels10240; four/six-slot windows, acceptance1..capacity.
confirmation.unit: microseconds per36-layer GDN commit sequence, from host submission through queue completion

correctness.coverage: Distinct per-layer state and inputs; capacities4/6, nonpositive through full acceptance; one/three/36 layers; different global input and local state origins, partial stage ranges, CPU history oracle, full-state parity and boundary canaries; captured graphs replay with changing device acceptance counts; unchanged inputs; unsupported-call refusal submits nothing.

integrated_model_validation.scope: Four cold correctness requests, not steady-state decode/prefill measurements.
